decisions.reason: Bare Business Analytics is a programme/subject label; official actual department identity retained in source evidence.

Actual Department of Business Analytics and Information Systems and Tobin parent officially verified. Qualifying Ops/OR remit remains insufficiently established: current page mentions preparation for future OR graduate study, not a substantive current specialization/research field. No invented eligible field.

sources.note: Official New York/Queens university department page read: exact Department of Business Analytics and Information Systems in The Peter J. Tobin College of Business; curriculum prepares students for further graduate study including Operations Research. That preparation statement alone does not establish a substantive current OR/Ops specialization or research remit.
Full current Tobin graduate page read: MBA variants, MS degrees and advanced certificates only. No business doctorate offered in this inventory.

Entire current A–W graduate programme degree list read. Mathematics/Computing/ML are MA, CS and AI/DataScience MS; no engineering doctorate. PhDs listed in biology, psychology, education/literacy, English, communication, pharmacy sciences and world history; no qualifying Operations/IE doctorate. Queens NY official university identity confirmed.

limitations: Official institutional and departmental identity verified; qualifying unit scope remains unresolved beyond generic analytics and preparation for later OR study.
No current relevant doctoral provision in complete opened graduate inventory; doctoral negative observation is separate from unit-scope question.
